title: Cabin Crew — Freshers Welcome
location: Delhi / Mumbai / Bengaluru / Multiple bases, India
description: Join IndiGo cabin crew. Freshers with good communication, customer service attitude and meeting airline eligibility (age, height, education) can apply when drives are open. Training provided after selection.

title: Cabin Crew Recruitment — Freshers
location: Delhi NCR / Hyderabad / Multiple cities, India
description: SpiceJet cabin crew openings for Indian nationals. Freshers encouraged when walks-in / online drives are announced. 10+2 minimum; English communication required.

title: Cabin Crew / In-Flight Services — Freshers
description: Air India cabin crew and in-flight service roles. Fresh graduates and first-time applicants can apply through official careers portal when positions are listed.

title: Cabin Crew — Entry Level
description: Akasa Air entry-level cabin crew. Freshers with positive attitude and service orientation welcome. Check official careers page for open drives.

title: Airport Customer Service Executive
description: Passenger check-in, boarding gate support and customer handling at major Indian airports. Ideal fresher role — training on airline systems provided.

title: Passenger Service Agent — Freshers
description: Airport passenger services for domestic flights. 12th pass / graduates. Shift work. Freshers with good English & Hindi preferred.

title: Ramp / Loading Executive
company: Bird Group / Celebi / Airport Ground Handler
description: Aircraft loading/unloading, baggage and ramp safety. Physically fit freshers welcome. Safety training given on joining.

title: Airline Ticketing / Reservations Executive
description: Domestic airline ticketing support (IndiGo, SpiceJet, Air India fares). GDS knowledge (Amadeus/Galileo) is a plus; freshers with ticketing course can apply.

title: Airport Security Screener (AVSEC) — Freshers
description: Passenger and baggage screening support roles. Clean background required. Freshers may join after security awareness / AVSEC training as applicable.

title: Airline Call Centre / Customer Care
company: Airline BPO / IndiGo & SpiceJet process partners
description: Handle flight bookings, changes, refunds and IRROPS queries for domestic airlines. Voice process — excellent English & Hindi. Freshers with night-shift flexibility preferred.

title: Graduate Trainee — Aviation Operations
description: Structured pathway for 12th pass / graduates into cabin crew, ground staff and airport customer service with domestic carriers (IndiGo, SpiceJet, Air India ecosystem). Contact Runway2Sky for guidance.

title: Airline Cargo Assistant — Freshers
company: Air India Cargo / Blue Dart Aviation partners
description: Air cargo documentation, warehouse support and airline handover. Graduates / diploma holders. Freshers with logistics interest welcome.

title: Aircraft Maintenance Technician Trainee
salary: As per AME training / airline norms
description: Entry path for AME students and aircraft maintenance freshers supporting domestic fleets (A320 family etc.). DGCA pathway preferred.

title: Airport Lounge Host / Hostess
description: Guest handling in airport lounges. Hospitality or cabin-crew aspirants welcome. Freshers with grooming & communication skills preferred.

title: Duty Free / Retail Sales Associate — Airport
description: Retail sales inside terminal (duty free / travel retail). Customer-facing fresher role with shift rosters.

title: Flight Operations Officer — Junior
description: Support flight planning, crew duty tracking and ops control for domestic network. Aviation diploma / fresher with ops course considered for junior posts.

title: Load & Trim / Load Controller Trainee
description: Learn load sheet and weight & balance for domestic aircraft. Science graduates / aviation diploma freshers preferred.

title: Airline HR / Campus Recruitment Coordinator
description: Coordinate fresher cabin crew and ground staff applications for Indian domestic airline drives. Freshers with HR interest can apply via contact form.
